Convert .sav file to .csv or xlxs
```{r}
library(foreign)
getwd()
```
```{r}
# make sure the dataset is located in your working directory

dfdemo = read.spss("W105_Mar22/W105_Mar22/ATP W105.sav")
```
```{r}
install.packages("xlsx")
library(xlsx)
write.xlsx(dfdemo, 'convertedDemo.xlsx')

```
